# The first UTF-8 truncation follow-up converts only the local byte distance

The intermediate patch introduces a size_t len temporary for cur minus begin and uses it in the limit comparison. The maxBytes parameter remains uint32_t here. The primary reports win32 build failure, while the reviewer later retracts a separate win64 concern; neither report establishes a fresh platform result or a general type-width rule. The parameter and caller changes belong to the following patch, and the accepted body has a later algorithm.

Scope: MailNews UTF-8 truncation build follow-up.
